title: Diverse via bounded Agreement: Geometric Regularization for Multimodal Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2601.21670v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal fusion is often treated as an optimization-balancing problem, where training signals are adjusted to prevent one modality from dominating the others. However, balanced optimization does not fully determine the geometry of intermediate representations. Supervised multimodal models may still learn low-diversity modality-specific embeddings or allow paired cross-modal observations to drift excessively apart, weakening both unimodal robustness and multimodal fusion.   We introduce \regName, a lightweight plug-and-play geometric regularization framework for multimodal representation learning. Rather than enforcing rigid cross-modal alignment, \regName follows a bounded-agreement principle: preserve modality-specific diversity while softly constraining only the portion of paired cross-modal drift that exceeds an admissible agreement band. translated_title: 通过有界一致性实现多样性：面向多模态融合的几何正则化
translated_abstract: 多模态融合通常被视为一个优化平衡问题，即通过调整训练信号来防止某一模态主导其他模态。然而，平衡优化并不能完全决定中间表示的几何结构。有监督的多模态模型仍可能学习到低多样性的模态特定嵌入，或使成对的跨模态观测过度漂移分离，从而同时削弱单模态的鲁棒性和多模态融合的效果。我们提出了\regName，一个用于多模态表示学习的轻量级即插即用几何正则化框架。\regName并不强制执行刚性的跨模态对齐，而是遵循有界一致性原则：在保留模态特定多样性的同时，仅对超出可接受一致性范围的成对跨模态漂移部分进行软性约束。在具体实现上，\regName结合了一个缓解谱集中的分散项……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种轻量级即插即用的几何正则化框架，通过有界一致性原则在保留模态特定多样性的同时，仅软性约束超出可接受范围的跨模态漂移，从而同时提升单模态鲁棒性与多模态融合效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a lightweight plug-and-play geometric regularization framework that preserves modality-specific diversity while softly constraining only the cross-modal drift exceeding an admissible agreement band, thereby improving both unimodal robustness and multimodal fusion.
